title: Registration Exemptions & Offerings

sections.heading: Exempt ISSUERS (issuer's identity = exempt)
items: U.S. Government & agencies
Municipalities (state/local)
National & state BANKS — NOT bank holding companies
Savings & Loans / Building & Loans
Charitable, religious, educational, nonprofit
Common carriers (e.g., railroad equipment trust certificates)

sections.heading: Exempt SECURITIES (the instrument is exempt)
items: Commercial paper, bankers' acceptances — maturity ≤ 270 days
Fixed annuities & insurance policies (NOT variable products)
Variable annuities / VUL / separate accounts = SECURITIES (must register)

items.Tier 2: Non-accredited capped at greater of 10% net worth or 10% income

sections.heading: Accredited Investor Thresholds (Rule 501)
items: Income: $200,000 individual OR $300,000 joint — past 2 yrs + expected current yr
Net worth: $1,000,000+ (EXCLUDES primary residence equity)
Insiders: officers, directors, 10%+ owners of the issuer
Licensed: holders in good standing of Series 7, 65, or 82
Knowledgeable employees of private funds; certain professional certifications
ALL institutional investors qualify

sections.heading: Rule 144A — QIBs (Qualified Institutional Buyers)
items: QIB = institution owning/investing ≥ $100 million in securities (discretionary)
Allows resale of restricted securities among QIBs without SEC registration
No retail involvement

sections.heading: Rule 147 — Intrastate Offering
items: Issuer HQ in state + ALL purchasers are state residents
Issuer must meet ONE of the 80% tests: 80% income IN-state / 80% assets IN-state / 80% of proceeds used IN-state / majority of employees in state
Underwriter (if any) must be based in the state
Resale to non-residents prohibited for 6 MONTHS after purchase

sections.heading: Private Placement Stock — Synonyms (all mean same thing)
items: Restricted stock (6-month holding under Rule 144)
Unregistered stock
Letter stock (investor signs investment letter)
Legend stock (legend on certificate restricts transfer)
Form 144 for affiliate resales — filed ELECTRONICALLY on EDGAR (paper no longer permitted as of 4/13/2023)

items.Offering: Reg A / Reg D / other exempt

sections.heading: Quick Number Recall
items: Commercial paper exemption: ≤ 270 days
Reg A Tier 1: $20M | Tier 2: $75M (per 12 mo)
Reg D 506(b): max 35 non-accredited
QIB minimum: $100M in securities
Accredited income: $200K / $300K joint | net worth $1M ex-home
Rule 147 resale restriction: 6 months
Rule 144 restricted stock holding period: 6 months

common_traps: BANK securities are exempt, but BANK HOLDING COMPANY securities are NOT exempt.
FIXED annuities/insurance are exempt; VARIABLE annuities/VUL are SECURITIES and must be registered.
Primary residence equity is EXCLUDED from the $1M net-worth test (a common distractor includes it).
Reg D 506(b) = NO advertising; 506(c) = advertising OK but ALL buyers must be accredited AND verified.
Rule 147 = intrastate only; Rule 144A = resales to QIBs only — don't confuse the two '14x' rules.
Commercial paper is exempt only if maturity ≤ 270 days — longer maturities must register.
